## Wind Rider — G4 stallion

**Who:** Wind Rider is a celebrated, aging **Pegasus and former Wonderbolt**—the supposedly honorable holder of the **Mustang Marathon** long-distance record. In *Rarity Investigates!* he secretly frames Rainbow Dash to stop her from surpassing him; Rarity exposes him, and Spitfire strips his Wonderbolts status. To pull off the scheme, he **disguises himself as an unnamed, raspy-voiced mare** (trench coat, sunglasses, headscarf) when buying a distracting cake, and **impersonates Stormy Flare** in a forged note. Neither disguise is a separate named character.

**Look:** Pale sky-blue coat, swept-back olive-gray mane and tail, golden/amber eyes, and his signature ivory scarf and dark flight jacket with a fluffy collar.

**Name and voice:** **Wind Rider** is spoken aloud by Rainbow Dash in the show, not a fan-invented background name. He **speaks**, voiced in English by **Jan Rabson**.

**Appearances:** *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* **S5E15, “Rarity Investigates!”** (September 19, 2015) is his main speaking role. *S7E7, “Parental Glideance”* briefly refers to him and shows his photograph; this is **not a new speaking appearance**.
